sub_site: plasma (peripheral blood) of healthy volunteers; stool and urine also profiled (not extracted)

evidence.quote: We collected blood, urine, and fecal samples from volunteers to compare their microbial information via 16S rDNA sequencing

controls.types: skin-surface sampling swabs; DNA extraction blank (nuclease-free water); no-template PCR control

decontamination.tool: Nejman et al. style removal of taxa found in blank/negative controls

after excluding DNA information from human sources and blank controls

notes: 36 plasma samples sequenced; 10 excluded after control-taxa removal left no/minimal reads; 26 blood samples analysed.
